name: background-boxes
title: Background Boxes
description: A skewed, flat, or perspective grid of tiles that light up under the cursor and fade back, using only CSS hover.

props.name: variant
props.description: skewed tilts the grid like an isometric floor, flat keeps it square, perspective lays it back toward the horizon.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of rows, up to 40. The grid stops at 600 tiles.

props.name: speed
props.description: Cycle of the few tiles that glow on their own: 9s, 6s, or 3.5s.

props.name: color
props.description: Token color a tile lights up with.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the grid.

a11y: The grid is aria-hidden and its tiles are not focusable.
Content lets the pointer through to the grid, except links, buttons, labels, and form fields, which stay clickable.
With reduced motion, tiles stop glowing on their own and change color without a fade.

ai.whenToUse: A playful hero, feature section, or promo banner where hovering the background is part of the fun.
rules: Set background color, padding, and radius with class on the component
Put cards or text blocks on bg-surface so they stay readable over lit tiles
Lower rows and cols on small areas instead of making tiles tiny

id.description: Grid kotak miring, datar, atau berperspektif yang menyala di bawah kursor lalu memudar, hanya dengan CSS hover.

props.variant: skewed memiringkan grid seperti lantai isometrik, flat membuatnya lurus, perspective merebahkannya ke arah cakrawala.
props.rows: Jumlah baris, maksimal 40. Grid berhenti di 600 kotak.
props.speed: Siklus beberapa kotak yang menyala sendiri: 9s, 6s, atau 3.5s.
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas grid.

a11y: Grid memakai aria-hidden dan kotaknya tidak bisa difokus.
Konten meneruskan pointer ke grid, kecuali tautan, tombol, label, dan kolom form yang tetap bisa diklik.
Dengan reduced motion, kotak berhenti menyala sendiri dan berganti warna tanpa transisi.

ai.whenToUse: Hero, section fitur, atau banner promo yang jenaka, di mana hover di latar menjadi bagian keseruan.
rules: Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
Letakkan kartu atau blok teks di atas bg-surface supaya tetap terbaca di atas kotak yang menyala
Kurangi rows dan cols di area kecil, jangan membuat kotak terlalu kecil
